name: Talon Bar
lede: Talon Bar’s lush backyard patio carried it through the pandemic, with Tungsten Electric heaters suspended from the ceiling over the guests.

hero.caption: Tungsten Electric over the plant-filled courtyard. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Talon is a bar in Brooklyn with a lush backyard patio.
The case study says the patio, with its heaters, helped the bar through the COVID-19 pandemic; it does not set out the brief.
Tungsten Smart-Heat Electric heaters, suspended from the ceiling, warm the patio. The case study gives no quantities.

products.name: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric
products.controls: To confirm – the source does not name them
